Parent #1926 (SC-03/SC-08) / #1645 (SC-10 reconnect element). Scoped child adding a deterministic reconnect fixture to the terminal consistency spec.

## Requirements: A relay reconnect keeps the renderer and loses no session output

### Problem

The suite proves a half-open Server socket creates a new physical socket and does not remount the Terminal (#1213), but the terminal-consistency fault spec has no reconnect witness that also checks the **stream**: output produced before the drop must not be duplicated, and a numbered burst after recovery must neither lose nor duplicate its tail.

### Scope

- Create and attach a Relay session, mark the current xterm DOM node, print a pre-drop marker (built through `printf` arguments so the echoed command never contains it), and wait for it exactly once.
- Force the reconnect deterministically: suppress `server.info`, toggle visibility hidden→visible, and wait for a new physical `/ws` socket.
- Assert the same xterm node survives, the Shell is visible again, and the pre-drop marker still occurs exactly once.
- After recovery, print a post marker and run a numbered burst; assert the post marker and the burst tail are exactly once (no duplicate, no missing tail line).

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 A forced Relay reconnect creates a new physical socket without remounting the xterm; the pre-drop marker remains exactly once.
- [ ] SC-02 After the reconnect, a post marker and a numbered burst tail are delivered exactly once — no silent gap and no duplicate in the retained tail.
- [ ] SC-03 Exact PR HEAD Quality / E2E / Case Smoke / trusted Acceptance, and exact merge-SHA Quality / E2E / Cases / Orchestrator Pass.

    when: pr

  SC-03:
